thread:
nina: Quick flag from today's onboarding run: sample-app showed a blank tool result after an auth retry during a streamed response. Repro easy in local.

sam: Can you paste the raw response you logged?

nina: Logged right after retry. Note the tool.args was a string: 

```
{"tool_call": {"name":"get_profile","args":"{\"user\":\"u123\",\"fields\":[\"name\"]}"}}
```

When the schema helper ran it expected args to be an object and returned {}. UI ended up with empty card.

marta: Hitting this in demo too. I patched the helper to attempt JSON.parse when args is a string; seemed to resolve locally.

sam: That's a fine bandaid, but we should avoid having transport emit stringified fields. Could be retry code re-stringified chunk.

olga: FYI python SDK already normalizes response payloads at transport boundary, so it doesn't hit this. Node parity issue.

nina: Also saw this only when streaming with chunked tool payloads, not in single-response flows.

sam: Action: (1) nina open a sample-app integration that simulates 401 then 200 with chunked tool payload (assign to nina). (2) sam to audit node retry/transport ordering. (3) keep helper defensive parse for now (marta). (4) olga to add parity note to SDK README.

ci-bot: Created DEVEX-1180: "node: streaming retry emits stringified tool args; normalize at transport" and linked failing test.

marta: Pushed helper PR with unit tests for string/object cases and a tiny JSON.parse guard. Marked as temporary in PR description.

sam: I'll dig into the retry wrapper; theory: cached chunk template used util.inspect in replay path which uses single quotes sometimes. If so, replacing with JSON.stringify should be trivial.

olga: Once fix lands in node SDK, we'll remove helper special-case and add cross-SDK tests.

nina: Thanks all. Leaving bandaid in place until transport fix + sample-app test land.

sam: Good triage. :thumbsup:
